name: Sonnet dividend growth and income
strategy: Anchor in quality dividend growers with AI-cycle exposure, add a tactical short against the most overextended leveraged momentum trade, use TLT for rate-cut convexity, and keep meaningful cash at 4% APY given stretched valuations after a huge H1 rally.

positions.thesis: Azure topped $100B annualized revenue growing 41-43%, 2026 capex raised to $175B; Citi just raised PT to $600 post-print. Durable AI-driven cash flow anchoring the dividend book, unchanged.

Samsung foundry/memory MOU plus fresh coverage framing AVGO as the biggest winner from the custom-AI-silicon shift reinforces multi-year FCF for dividend growth; holding size given ongoing China-component-ban headline risk.
Diversified quality dividend-growth ballast; kept as core holding while valuations stay stretched and volatility (gold/semis squeeze) rises elsewhere in the tape.
Trading near its $363 52-week high after the no-news dip was bought; Dimon's leverage-risk comments are a watch item but no thesis break in a best-in-class rising-dividend compounder.
Record Q2 earnings just reported (net income +385% YoY) with Wall Street turning more bullish; energy dividend aristocrat remains the book's inflation/rate-backdrop diversifier.
Token position kept at trimmed size — TLT is still pinned near 52-week lows, so rate-cut odds and the housing-turnover catalyst remain weak; not adding back until yields roll over.
Kept as a minimal growth-scare/tail hedge only; price ($82.76) still sits near the bottom of its 52-week range, confirming rate-cut convexity has not returned.
Defensive staples dividend ballast, low-beta complement to the AI-cycle names; unchanged.

reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-08: Closing the SOXL short: the leveraged-semis squeeze the packet flagged (SOXL +5.98% on 8/7 alone, up ~23% since 7/30) is running directly against this unprotected equity short, and this book already took partial profits on it once as extended-momentum risk; better to lock in the remaining gain and remove the exposure than let a further squeeze erode it, especially with no stop attached. Everything else in the dividend book is unchanged this week — MSFT (Citi PT raised to $600 post-Azure), AVGO (AI custom-silicon tailwind), CVX (record Q2 earnings, +385% YoY net income), JPM (near 52w high) and SCHD/XLP/HD/TLT all have intact theses with no new information to act on, so those are held as-is rather than churned.
research_notes: Checked live prices/news through 2026-08-07 close for both books.
